guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (right-handed, played upside-down/restrung for left hand)
guitar.evidence: Jimi Hendrix's white Fender Stratocaster (and his left-handed restringing of right-handed Strats) is among the most iconic and exhaustively documented guitar setups in rock history.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown; one of the most famous guitar/guitarist pairings in music history.

tone.target: clean, glassy Hendrix chordal sparkle with light breakup
tone.profile: clean, glassy Hendrix chordal sparkle with light breakup
tone.summary: A classic clean signal chain utilizing a transparent pre-amp (Green OD) for light grit, followed by a British clean amp model (UK 50 or US Deluxe) paired with a vintage cabinet and subtle room ambience to capture the glassy sparkle of 'Little Wing'.
corrections: Keep ambience subtle, not washed out

rig.name: The Jimi Hendrix Experience - Little Wing - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide transparent, light touch breakup and sparkle without aggressive crunch.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more grit than Green OD, but still suitable.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright tone of a Fender-style amplifier.

alternatives.reason: Excellent alternative for classic clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, articulate sound suitable for single-coil guitars.

alternatives.reason: If the tone needs more body than pure sparkle.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the high end and clarity for 'glassy' sparkle.
Avoid chorus as per instructions; kept for potential subtle movement.
blocks.gap: The target tone suggests minimal modulation. If needed, a very slow rate Chorus could add depth.

blocks.purpose: Provide the subtle spring space and vintage ambience required.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if Spring is too metallic.

blocks.purpose: Avoid big delay wash; kept for potential subtle repeats.
blocks.gap: The target tone requires minimal or no noticeable delay. This is a standby module.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism and tonal depth by swapping the default IR for a more open, glassy Fender-style cab.

proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is too closed; a larger, open cabinet will enhance the glassy sparkle and articulation needed for 'Little Wing'.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and openness in the high end.
